I see friends and family in person almost every weekend. I work in the office. I never work remotely. I have constant, positive contact with other human beings. I have no social media other than this account, which perhaps qualifies.

I'm in my 50's. I have an ordinary job. I'm not a homesteader or recluse. I just made a series of choices about how I want to live my life, and this is what it's turned into.
